Though her parents were young and dedicated to their dangerous careers, they raised her with love and care. Shiranui even stepped back from missions for a time to focus on Yukikaze’s training, nurturing her alongside her childhood friends Rinko and Tatsuro. Growing up in the isolated Mizuki Mansion, Yukikaze often felt lonely but thrived under her parents’ guidance, quickly proving herself as a prodigy in combat and ninjutsu.

From an early age, Yukikaze displayed extraordinary talent, awakening her Lightning Art abilities with immense power. She enrolled at Gosha Academy, where she was recognized as part of the next generation of elite Taimanin, alongside future mentors like Asagi and Sakura. By her early teens, she and Rinko had already completed an advanced training program, graduating years ahead of their peers. Despite her youth, Yukikaze’s potential was undeniable, marking her as a rising star in the Taimanin ranks.

However, tragedy struck when her mother vanished during a mission in the criminal underworld of Yomihara. Despite her father’s relentless search, Shiranui was never found. Four years later, Yukikaze’s father also fell in the line of duty, leaving her orphaned. Though devastated, she refused to give up, dedicating herself to uncovering the truth behind her mother’s disappearance. Her parents’ legacy became both her burden and her driving force, pushing her to become stronger.

Now known as the "Lightning Taimanin," Yukikaze wields incredible power but struggles with control. Her Lightning Art is so destructive that she must use limiters to restrain it, though her raw strength continues to grow unpredictably. While her lack of finesse sometimes causes collateral damage, her potential impresses even veteran Taimanin. She frequently operates alongside Rinko or in specialized squads, balancing her fierce combat skills with her lingering emotional wounds.

At her core, Yukikaze is defined by her unwavering determination. Though haunted by loss, she channels her grief into her missions, clinging to the hope of one day finding her mother. Her journey is one of power, discipline, and resilience—a prodigy burdened by legacy but driven by love. Whether facing enemies or her own limitations, Yukikaze fights not just as a Taimanin, but as a daughter seeking answers.

She likes swimming, and her tan lines are the result. This suntan, doesn't go away, even if she spends a year underground. Based on her mother, she spent even her youth a lot outside, catching tiny fish and insects.

entries.name: Taima Particles

Taima Particles, they are also called Anti Demon Particles or just Particles, they are a substance that serves as the basis of a Taimanin's power.

The Taima particles can be imbued to one's body, clothes or weapon, to enhance the offensive and defensive capabilities; it can be transformed into energy that enables superhuman feats and supernatural abilities.
